components.name: Destructive Button

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; whitespace: nowrap; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); disabled:pointer-events-none; disabled:opacity-0.5; outline: none; padding: 0.6875rem 1rem; min-height: 2.75rem; background: #F9F8F6; color: #1D2129; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #F0A202; color: #1D2129; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border: #D95D39; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217, 93, 57, 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form text field; transparent background, Pale Border stroke, gently rounded; focus ring in Laterite Earth.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; color: #1D2129; transition: color, box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; min-height: 2.75rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #65676B; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border: #D95D39; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217, 93, 57, 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border: #dc2626; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: Ntum is an earthy, textured design system built for field officers working on shared low-end Android devices with intermittent signal, and for admin staff running programs from the command center. The visual language draws on African material culture — bogolan mud-cloth patterns, recycled paper grain, and woven overlays — rendered as lightweight inline SVG textures that require zero external image requests. The palette is anchored in two brand themes: sunset (default, earth-orange and amber-gold) and ocean (teal and sand), each with light and dark variants. System font stacks (sans-serif for UI, serif for display headings) replace webfonts entirely, keeping the build and the offline field app independent of external network calls. The aesthetic philosophy is restraint with warmth: flat surfaces by default, subtle shadows only where they communicate state, generous tap targets, icons always paired with labels, and plain language throughout. Motion is minimized and gated by prefers-reduced-motion. The system is usable in five languages (en, de, fr, es, ar, including RTL) and designed for low digital literacy — every destructive action confirms, every empty state explains, every error offers a next step.
keyCharacteristics: Earth-orange primary (#D95D39) and amber-gold accent (#F0A202) used sparingly, never dominant
Dual brand themes (sunset default, ocean alternative) with light/dark mode, four combinations total
Inline SVG textures (bogolan, paper, woven) as subtle overlays, never competing with content
System font stacks only — Georgia serif for display, sans-serif system stack for body and labels
Flat-by-default surfaces with shadow-sm on cards and focus-ring states on interactive elements
Honest offline, empty, and error states in all five supported locales

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Laterite Earth (primary) and Harvest Gold (accent) together cover no more than 10% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, elevation) and never as permanent decoration.

rules.name: The Label-With-Icon Rule
rules.body: Icons never appear without an accompanying text label. Non-negotiable for low-digital-literacy users and Arabic RTL locales.

dos: Do use Laterite Earth (#D95D39) for primary actions only; keep it under 10% of screen area (The One Accent Rule).
Do pair every icon with a text label (The Label-With-Icon Rule).
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; use shadow-sm only on cards (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
Do use system font stacks only — no webfont downloads, ever (offline-first constraint).
Do keep touch targets at least 44px; form controls use h-11 (2.75rem) height minimum.
donts: Don't use Harvest Gold (#F0A202) as a background on large surfaces; it is an accent, not a field color.
Don't apply rounded corners beyond the sm–lg scale (0.375rem–0.75rem); no pill-shaped buttons.
Don't add ambient shadows for decoration; shadows communicate state only.
Don't use all-caps for labels or button text; sentence case throughout.
Don't load external images or fonts; textures are inline SVG data URIs and fonts are system stacks.
